sample_id: sample_id: <s>_<project acronym and last 2 digits of the year>_<experiment number>_<3 digits sample number>
sample_form: in which form the sample is stored before analysis
origin: origin (supplier or location) of the sample
available_from: year (or date) from which the sample is available
info_file: name of the file with additional information on the sample
cas_nr: CAS registry number of the compound
arrival_date: If the exact date not known 1/1 is put
ref_nr: reference (article) number of the product at the supplier
drymatter_g_per_kg: dry matter content (g per kg fresh matter)
ash_g_per_kg_dm: ash content (g per kg dry matter)
crude_fibre_g_per_kg_dm: crude fibre content (g per kg dry matter)
crude_protein_g_per_kg_dm: crude protein content (g per kg dry matter)
crude_fat_g_per_kg_dm: crude fat content (g per kg dry matter)
adf_g_per_kg_dm: acid detergent fibre (ADF) content (g per kg dry matter)
ndf_g_per_kg_dm: neutral detergent fibre (NDF) content (g per kg dry matter)
starch_g_per_kg_dm: starch content (g per kg dry matter)
sugar_g_per_kg_dm: sugar content (g per kg dry matter)
